The Headland Cape Yamu

Вилла — Cape Yamu (Pa Khlok, Thalang)
ГлавнаяНовые проектыThe Headland Cape Yamu

Photos from the project website: the villas, their pools and views from Cape Yamu.

О проекте

The Headland is a small estate of eight villas at the tip of Cape Yamu, the narrow headland in Pa Khlok on Phuket's quieter east coast, beside the COMO Point Yamu resort. The site covers about 5,846 sqm and looks out over Phang Nga Bay. Construction was completed in December 2023.

The villas are two storeys with four bedrooms and four bathrooms. Residents share a pool and gym, with parking, 24-hour security and CCTV; pets are allowed. The common fee is THB 40 per sqm of plot per month. Restaurants on the cape, including The Mermaid, are within a five-minute walk, and the beach at Cape Yamu is a short walk downhill.

Cape Yamu is about 33 minutes from the airport and about 25 minutes from Phuket Town, which suits owners looking for privacy rather than a west-coast beach scene. No current asking prices are published, so contact us for resale availability.
